name: Dan Hooker

face.shape: Long, narrow-to-medium rectangular face with a tall forehead, flat lean cheeks and an angular lower face. Reads long and bony rather than broad.
face.jaw: Angular and fairly long; the jaw line runs at a clear angle from below the ears to the chin under the beard. No softness under the jaw.
face.chin: Medium width, squared off by the beard, projecting slightly. The beard lengthens it a little.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high and defined, with flat to slightly hollow cheeks below.
face.brow_ridge: Fairly prominent. Under top light the eyes look deep-set and shadowed (ESPN headshot, Paris face-off).
face.forehead: Tall and broad, with faint horizontal lines. The bleached hair makes the hairline low-contrast against the skin.

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped, slightly narrow, with hooded upper lids; outer corners level to slightly downturned.
eyes.spacing: Average, about one eye width apart.
eyes.colour: Light grey-blue with a slight green tint (studio headshot; the 2016 frame also reads light). Closest embed iris: grey (blue acceptable).

eyebrows.thickness: Thin to medium and fairly sparse
eyebrows.shape: Low and nearly straight, with a slight drop at the tails.
eyebrows.colour: Light ginger-brown, low contrast against the skin; they almost disappear in bright light next to the bleached hair.

nose.width: Narrow to medium along the bridge, with a medium, slightly rounded tip.
nose.bridge: Straight and fairly narrow; in profile (Paris face-off) the line runs straight from the brow to the tip.
nose.tip: Medium, slightly rounded, pointing a touch down.
nose.fight_damage: No clear deformity in these photos.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, partly hidden by the moustache.
mouth.resting_expression: Closed and neutral. Smiles broadly and often at media days, showing straight upper teeth (UFC 325, Paris).

ears.protrusion: Stand out slightly from the head; more visible since the sides were skin-faded (Sept 2026).
ears.cauliflower_ear: No clear cauliflower ear. The right upper ear may be slightly thickened in the studio headshot, but it is minor.
ears.notes: Model as normal ears with slight protrusion.

face.notable_marks_scars: A small red mark or cut on his LEFT upper cheek just below the inner corner of the eye shows in three photos (ESPN headshot, UFC 325 Jan 2026, Paris Sept 2026). It may be a cut that keeps reopening or a fresh scar; model it faintly at most. Light freckling across the forehead and nose. No large facial scars.

hair.style: Bleached platinum-blond top, about 5-6 cm, textured and swept up and back. In the studio photos (late 2025 and 2026 shoots) the sides are short and tapered (about 1.5 cm). By Paris fight week (Sept 2026) the sides and back are a high skin fade, which makes the bleached top look like a block.
hair.length_notes: sides about 1.5 cm in the studio shoots, skin fade (about 0.3 cm) in September 2026
hair.colour: Bleached platinum blond, ash-white in neutral studio light and pale yellow under warm press-conference light. His natural colour (2022 London weigh-in) is medium brown, so any regrowth or eyebrows read darker than the top.
hair.hairline: Full and fairly straight, with slightly rounded temple corners. No recession visible.
hair.texture: Straight; fine and slightly dry-looking from the bleach.

facial_hair.colour: Ginger to strawberry-brown, clearly warmer than his natural brown hair and much darker than the bleached top. Lighter, more ginger on the moustache and upper cheeks.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin and jaw line, moderate on the cheeks.
facial_hair.length_notes: About 10-15 mm in the 2025-2026 photos, about 20 mm at the chin point.
facial_hair.shape: Full short beard joined to the moustache. Natural cheek line at mid-cheek; neckline under the jaw. Slightly longer on the chin, giving a squared point.

skin.excluded_samples: Foreheads hit highlights in all three photos; a Paris 'beard' sample landed on the lip and was dropped.
skin.undertone: Warm pink, fair and ruddy; reddens around the eyes and nose.
skin.freckles_marks: Light freckles on the forehead and nose. Most of the torso, both arms and both lower legs are tattooed (see tattoos).

body.build: Tall, long-limbed and wiry for a lightweight (former featherweight): 183 cm with a 190.5 cm reach, so the arms are clearly long for his height.
body.body_fat_notes: Lean with visible abs and obliques; not bulky anywhere.
body.shoulders: Medium width, slightly sloping; delts defined but not big.
body.arms: Long, lean arms with defined but slim muscle; the forearms are long. Lanky rather than thick.
body.waist: Narrow, with little taper from chest to waist because the chest is not wide.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with lean thighs and slim, defined calves.
body.posture: Upright and loose, shoulders relaxed. In the studio cutouts the long arms hang almost straight, gloves at mid-thigh. Listed as a switch-stance fighter (data/scouting: a tall kickboxer who works at range with jabs, long straights, front kicks and leg kicks).
body.notable_physique_traits: Height, long arms and legs, and dense tattoo coverage are the silhouette cues. Narrow frame overall.

tattoos.where: Right arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey sleeve. A hooded grim-reaper skeleton (skull, ribcage and spine) fills the outer upper arm, set in heavy black shading with flowing ribbon-like bands of bare skin (negative space) that curl around the arm down to the wrist. Some lighter ornamental scrollwork near the shoulder.

tattoos.where: Left arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey sleeve. On the upper arm and shoulder, a hooded skull figure in a lace-edged veil with a crown of thorns; on the forearm, a robed skeleton figure with both arms raised, surrounded by smoke-like shading. A small skull near the inner elbow.

tattoos.where: Chest, centred on the sternum and spreading across both pecs
tattoos.description: Large black-and-grey skull with long downward fangs or horns. A sword runs vertically through the top of the skull, its hilt at the base of the throat. Crossed swords, battle axes and daggers radiate from behind the skull like a starburst.
tattoos.size: About 35 cm wide x 35 cm tall, from the base of the throat to the upper abdomen

tattoos.where: Lower abdomen, across the belly from hip to hip just above the waistband, around the navel
tattoos.description: Wide line of spiky black blackletter script in a stylised metal-band font; the word is not legible in these photos.
tattoos.size: About 30 cm wide x 10 cm tall

tattoos.where: Right leg, from the knee down the shin and over the top of the foot
tattoos.description: Maori-style curvilinear design: koru spirals and long curved bands in black with fine hatched fill, running down the front of the shin onto the foot and toes.

tattoos.where: Left leg, from the knee down the shin and over the top of the foot, plus a ring design just above the knee
tattoos.description: Norse or Celtic knotwork: interlaced serpents and beasts with dragon-like heads in black, running down the shin onto the top of the foot. A circular knotwork design sits on the lower thigh above the knee.
tattoos.size: Whole lower leg and foot, about 10 cm ring above the knee

tattoos.where: Right side of the neck, from just under the right ear down toward the shoulder
tattoos.description: Large black spider with long legs. Not present in the January 2026 media-day photo or the studio cutouts, but clearly visible at UFC Paris fight week (Sept 3-4, 2026), so it is a 2026 addition.
tattoos.size: About 12 cm tall x 10 cm wide

tattoos_note: His back is not visible in any photo, so back tattoos are unknown. Both sleeves continue to the wrists; the hands look mostly bare apart from rings.
accessories_seen: Several silver rings on both hands (UFC 325 and Paris media days).

kit.typical_shorts: UFC-issued black shorts with a darker grey scalloped wave print, a white-and-black checkerboard band on the waistband, a white UFC wordmark on the front panel and the right leg, crypto.com logo on his RIGHT thigh, and white vertical 'HOOKER' lettering on his LEFT thigh (studio cutouts).
kit.gloves: Standard black UFC studio gloves; corner-coloured cuffs on fight night.
kit.brand_note: No apparel brand is legible; describe them as UFC-issued.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: Ear targets live in assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (not mh-manifest.json); avatar3d.js reads this block.

render_hints.skin_base: middleage_caucasian_male tinted toward tone_hex #c98a77 (fair, warm pink)
render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow001 (the thinner one), tinted #a07258 so they stay low-contrast
render_hints.hair: strand shell about 3-5 cm on top, tinted #e3cdb0 (platinum), with short faded sides; the bleached top over darker brows and a ginger beard is the key colour contrast
render_hints.beard: short full beard 10-15 mm, ginger-brown #7a5040, longer at the chin
render_hints.tattoos: full sleeves on both arms, large chest skull, belly script, Maori-style right shin, knotwork left shin, spider on the right side of the neck (2026 look)

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, tattoos and build; medium for face proportions and eye colour; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 8 photos (1 Commons CC BY 3.0 webcam frame from 2016, 7 reference-only, 5 of them from late 2025 to Sept 2026). There is a good right-side profile (Paris weigh-in) but no left profile and no view of his back. What to watch: (1) The bleached platinum top against ginger-brown beard and pale brows is the strongest recognition cue; do not tint the beard to match the hair. (2) Tattoo coverage is almost total on the arms, chest, belly and lower legs; an untattooed Hooker will not read as him. Arms: reaper on the RIGHT, crowned hooded skull on the LEFT. Legs: Maori style on the RIGHT, Norse knotwork on the LEFT. (3) The neck spider is new in 2026; include it for a current look. (4) Long arms (reach 7.6 cm over height) and long legs; keep the frame narrow and wiry. (5) Face is long and lean with deep-set light eyes. Macro values: ageOldM uses avatar3d.js's (age-25)/65 mapping (age 36). heightUpM 0.15 is a guess for 182.9 cm; scale to the official height. MakeHuman l-/r- morphs refer to the character's own left and right.
